name: Playful Cloud
description: A special-grade cursed tool in the form of a three-section staff. A reputable ORICON feature on Maki Zenin describes her expertise with cursed tools and identifies Playful Cloud as one of the weapons in her arsenal.
origin: A special-grade cursed tool in the Jujutsu Kaisen continuity; detailed creation history is not verified in the current source set.
strengths: Destructive output is closely tied to the wielder’s physical strength.
specialAbilities: Functions as a close-range three-section staff; no unique innate technique is assigned in the source used.
